meta.name: MaisonFav (reference only)
meta.description: Architectural place finding template on Aura. A reference for moves and proportions. Not a source of code, and not the TPS brand.
source_references: https://maisonfav.aura.build/ (public page, read in a browser on 5 Oct 2026)

color.palette_type: monochromatic neutral with one pale accent

neutral.usage: page ground #F5F5F2, text #090B0C, secondary text black at 45 to 65 percent

color.contrast_strategy: near black on warm off white, secondary text as translucent black
color.measurement: computed styles read from the live page, not sampled from pixels

font_families.heading: DM Sans, with Instrument Serif italic for one phrase

typography.font_style_notes: very tight tracked grotesque headlines with one slanted serif phrase per statement. Tiny tracked uppercase labels.

spacing.section_rhythm: 160px above and below most sections, 96 to 144 on others, cards pulled up by 8vh

layout.grid_system: single column sections with 2 column heading and caption rows
layout.max_content_width: 896px for text, wider for photo cards
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed: centred hero, left aligned sections

border_radius.large: 16px, top corners only on stacked cards

shape.divider_style: hairline rules and a short line before overline labels

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping sticky layers, translucent white glass on the bar

iconography.preferred_set: Iconify line icons, arrow in a circle

motion.entrance_pattern: soft rise and fade on scroll (inferred)

components.button_style: black pill, 44px tall, 12px label, a 32px white circle with an arrow inside on the right
components.input_style: not observed on the studied sections
components.card_style: photo cards 72vh tall with 16px top corners, sticky, stacked with offsets of about 66px
components.navigation_pattern: slim bar, logo left, four tracked links, one pill button
components.component_notes: the stacked photo card is the signature component: each card sticks lower than the one before so the top edges stay visible

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous, used as the main luxury signal
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: photography carries the weight, type stays light
visual_language.focal_strategy: one large image or statement per screen
visual_language.contrast_level: high between ink and ground, low between neighbouring greys

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast between a huge headline and 12px labels
composition.grouping_strategy: heading left, caption right, content below

imagery.photo_treatment: full colour architectural photography, soft light, no filters

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short verbs: Begin a search, View residence

overview.fallback_strategy: cards fall back to normal flow on small screens (inferred)
overview.primary_technology: CSS sticky positioning, Tailwind, small amounts of script

background_effects.type: soft mist gradient under the hero photograph
background_effects.description: the hero image fades into the page ground with a white fog

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: not scrubbed except the sticky stack

scroll_morphing.description: stacked cards slide over each other, each sticky at a lower offset

text_effects.description: tight grotesque with one slanted serif phrase

cursor_effects.description: 12px circle, white with difference blending so it shows dark on light. TJ does not want this on TPS.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The look comes from restraint, scale contrast and space, not from effects. Only the sticky stack and the hero fog are distinctive. Everything else is typography and photography. Items marked inferred were not directly observed.
